_provenance.what_this_is: Statistical analysis plan shell for time-to-event research. The validator checks that the planning fields are defined and internally consistent. It does not read time-to-event rows, fit models, or produce an individual prognosis.
_provenance.status_default: Distributed unresolved on purpose; a non-zero validator result is expected until completed.
_provenance.reconstruction: Reconstructed from references/survival_analysis.md and the estimand framing in ICH E9(R1).

estimand.condition_or_comparison: unresolved - intervention, exposure, or groups contrasted
estimand.intercurrent_event_strategy: unresolved - how discontinuation, rescue therapy, switching, and competing events relate to the question
estimand.population_level_summary: unresolved - risk, survival probability, restricted mean survival time, hazard contrast, or quantile
estimand.delayed_entry: unresolved - yes or no, and the entry rule

endpoint.censoring_rules: unresolved - including loss to follow-up and administrative censoring
endpoint.note: Do not treat a competing event as ordinary independent censoring when the target is absolute event probability.

descriptive_estimation.primary_method: unresolved - Kaplan-Meier, cumulative incidence, or other
descriptive_estimation.competing_event_method: unresolved - state whether cumulative incidence is used and why

group_comparison.primary_test_or_model: unresolved - log-rank, Cox, RMST, or other
group_comparison.alternatives_if_ph_doubtful: unresolved - time-varying coefficients, piecewise, landmark, RMST, differences at prespecified times, AFT or flexible parametric
group_comparison.no_hr_as_risk_reduction: Avoid interpreting 1 - HR as a reduction in cumulative risk.

competing_risks.question_type: unresolved - cause-specific hazard, cumulative incidence / absolute risk, or subdistribution hazard
competing_risks.note: A subdistribution hazard ratio is not directly a risk ratio. Naively censoring competing events in Kaplan-Meier can overestimate absolute incidence.

bias_and_missingness.sensitivity_analyses: unresolved - tied to plausible departures from assumptions; a best/worst case alone is rarely sufficient

uncertainty_and_multiplicity.multiplicity_strategy: unresolved - across outcomes, times, subgroups, models
uncertainty_and_multiplicity.note: Do not turn a threshold-crossing p-value into clinical importance.

boundary_statement: This is a statistical analysis plan for research. It analyzes no individual and forecasts no individual's course. Not for patient care or live clinical use.
